question: Identify all distinct artists who illustrated borderless cards that (a) appear in at least one Russian-language printing, (b) have rulings associated with them, and (c) possess incredibly powerful foils—defined as having both cardKingdomId and cardKingdomFoilId not null. Return the artists sorted alphabetically.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_002"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_082"
INNER JOIN rulings AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_090"
WHERE T1."XCL_005" = 'borderless'
  AND T2."XCL_077" = 'Russian'
  AND T1."XCL_006" IS NOT NULL
  AND T1."XCL_007" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1."XCL_002" ASC
